articles.summary: M-tron Industries, Inc. ("Mtron" or the "Company") today reminded investors that it will host its previously announced Investor Day on Tuesday, May 12, 2026 and encourages all interested attendees to register. The event will feature presentations from members of the Company's executive leadership team, who will provide an overview of Mtron's strategy, operational priorities, and long-term growth initiatives. Management will also discuss recent business developments and financial performance, followed by a question-and-answer session. Event Details: Date: May 12, 2026 Time: 12:00 p.m. to 1:30 p.m. ET Location: New York Stock Exchange 11 Wall Street New York, NY 10005 A replay of the webcast and presentation materials will be made available on the Investor Relations section of Mtron's website at ir.mtron.com following the conclusion of the event. Investors and other parties interested in attending in person will need to register in advance by contacting the Company's Investor Relations
articles.title: M-tron Industries, Inc. Reminds Investors of Upcoming Investor Day on May 12, 2026
